Привет, Том, надеюсь, у тебя всё хорошо.
I'm writing to confirm our meeting.

texts.title: An email to a colleague
texts.text: Hi Sarah, I hope this email finds you well. I'm writing to confirm our meeting with the client on Thursday at 10 a.m. Please find attached the latest version of the presentation. Unfortunately, Mark can't join us, so we may need to postpone the second part of the discussion until next week. Could you please check the agenda and let me know if anything is missing? I'd also appreciate it if you could prepare a short summary of the budget. Thanks in advance. Best regards, Dmitry
